name: fi-annual-real-estate-tax
description: Compute Finland's 2026 annual real-estate tax for owners of land and buildings, including separate land/building ownership, co-owners and nonresident owners. Determine liability on 1 January, establish the preceding year's statutory valuation, classify each component and apply the municipality's adopted rate. Covers ordinary residential and commercial property, building replacement values, age reductions, land target-value transitions, unbuilt sites, Åland deviations, corrections and payment. Trigger on kiinteistövero, property-tax decision, building value, annual tax, municipal real-estate rate or property information corrections. Transfer tax on buying property and income tax on rent or gains are separate computations in the companion skills.
